Identity: long narrow mature olive face, pronounced curved nose, close-set dark eyes, deep smile lines, dark eyebrows, thin lips with warm wide smile, short dark hair with slight gray at the temples, very light stubble; faithfully draw the face in image 1. No detached props. Adult natural proportions, about seven head lengths.
Shallow three-quarter view so BOTH eyes and face are visible, with gaze, forward foot and all attacks directed to the opponent at screen RIGHT. Never face LEFT or show the back.
POSES in exact reading order: 0 compact relaxed ready guard, hands at mid-chest, cheerful determined expression, knees gently bent; 1 distinct raised blocking guard by face; 2 running RIGHT left knee forward/right leg back; 3 running RIGHT right knee forward/left leg back, clearly opposite stride; 4 tucked-knee airborne jump with both feet visibly off ground; 5 straight punch fully extended RIGHT with other hand guarding; 6 high side kick extended RIGHT, planted supporting foot; 7 recoil from a hit, leaning back but still looking RIGHT.
Real transparent alpha outside silhouettes and between legs; no backdrop, floor, shadow, grid, border, labels, text, particles, aura or watermark.
